purpose: Keep Atlas as canonical ProgBase AutoCal authority while making downstream runtime/product consumers pass replay, safety, governance and UI/UX constraints before claiming parity.
canonical_rule: ProgBase EXE + raw Portmon/LOGNOVO + reproducible Atlas proof always outrank consumer fixtures, product labels, UI behavior or branch-local assumptions.

transversal_gate.rule: Reuse the existing transversal gate; do not create a parallel governance authority.

amarelo: render fixture kept separate from scientific inference
verde: single clear human commit point after prepared preview
automatic checkpoint/validation/ACK/readback behind the human action
current Map K / Curve K / Predictor product integration

product_refinement_policy.human_commit: One explicit final human write confirmation is allowed after a visible prepared preview; scientific validation, checkpoint, ACK/readback and recovery remain mandatory automatic gates.
product_refinement_policy.consumer_truth: Consumer/runtime evidence may detect integration drift but cannot redefine original ProgBase semantics.
product_refinement_policy.ui_truth: UI formats typed state; it never invents readiness, confidence, thresholds, physics, protocol meaning or scientific progress.
product_refinement_policy.lifecycle: Navigation and screen mount/unmount must not start/stop or materially retime the scientific acquisition engine.
product_refinement_policy.progress: Do not invent percentages; expose actual stage, recent activity, elapsed time and liveness.

invalidation_events: Atlas semantic or behavioral closure is reopened
consumer action/protocol fixture drifts from Atlas
write path loses preview, ACK/readback or recovery
live Notion Contract Registry changes applicable UI/UX obligations
